_why: Spec mode has one authoritative live state. A successful engine Plan transition emits a structured edge; the shell persists it before publishing it, and the composer badge consumes that same edge. This prevents denied or failed tool calls from lighting the badge and prevents agent-entered Plan mode from diverging from the session_chat_modes row. The proactive proposal is a CONSULTATION, not a permission request: it travels the elicitation channel (metadata.tool = suggest_execution_mode, structured two-choice question) so no permission mode — including skip-all — can swallow it or auto-answer it; the engine flips to Plan only from the user's answer.

webFetchNetworkApproval._why: Fetching a public page is read-only Spec research. Plan skips only web_fetch network confirmation; explicit tool deny/ask rules, domain policy, private-network protection, other network tools, and write restrictions retain their existing behavior.
